name: armless prayer stretch
description: A kneeling child's-pose stretch with the arms resting alongside the body, allowing the back and hips to relax.
instructions: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Fold your torso forward and let your forehead rest on the floor or on a cushion.
Relax your arms alongside your legs with your palms facing up, rather than reaching them forward.
Breathe slowly and hold for a comfortable duration.
